notes.page_account: The sheet continues a description of compact moderate spaces by diagrams of manifolds with boundary. The principal arrows are described as locally trivial fibrations and boundary inclusions, with a qualification allowing more general inclusions among pieces of an elementary cellular decomposition. The closed strata are described as manifolds with boundary glued along common boundary parts. The author then states a canonical description-dévissage of the compact spaces and begins explaining constructible sheaves, complexes of sheaves or n-champs in terms of the diagram. The final sentence continues off the sheet.
notes.author_explicit_uncertainty: There is no direct question or explicit confession of uncertainty on this sheet. The exact phrases pour l’essentiel, légèrement plus générales, and éventuellement munis are qualifications in the prose. Editorial uncertainty in this return is not attributed to the author.
notes.page_date_title: Author page number 34 is centered at the top. Archive pencil number 179 is at the lower left and is retained only in a comment. No date, title, heading, closing or signature occurs on this sheet.

There is no displayed formula, drawn diagram, independent margin note, separator stroke or footnote. The left-margin finis is an attached insertion. Line-end word divisions inside the page were joined, and the sheet ends after dont il without a supplied stop or continuation.

The terminal note says the quoted adjective may carry a plural mark. The final hook is indeed visible; this reader prefers élémentaires but retains élémentaire.
